subject: Copywriting
title: Event-Triggered Emails
description: A micro-lesson that makes Event-Triggered Emails usable.

hook.text: Triggered emails—sent when a user acts—get 8x more opens than scheduled blasts. Timing is everything.

buildup.text: Events trigger emails: purchase, browse, download, birthday, inactivity.

discovery.text: Event-Triggered Emails reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: Over-triggering creates fatigue. Buy a shirt, get five emails. Browse once, get stalked for a month. Restraint matters.

climax.text: The best triggered emails feel helpful, not surveillant. 'Your free trial ends tomorrow' helps.

punchline.text: Right message, right moment. Triggered emails are 8x more relevant.

quiz.question: How many more opens do triggered emails get compared to scheduled ones?
